title: Combinations and factorials
intro: Count line-ups or choose groups on the TI-Nspire CX II-T.

beats.spoken: Start on a Calculator page. The same five badges can be lined up or chosen for a display.
beats.coach: Five badges: does swapping positions make a new outcome? Yes for a line-up. No for a group without roles.

beats.spoken: For a line-up of all five, type the number first. Choose Factorial to put the exclamation mark after it.
beats.coach: Type 5. Menu → 5: Probability → 1: Factorial adds ! after it. Press Enter.

beats.spoken: The factorial counts complete line-ups. Change the order and you have a different line-up.
beats.coach: 5! = 5 × 4 × 3 × 2 × 1 = 120 exactly. Swapping two badges changes the line-up.

beats.spoken: This time choose two badges for a display with no roles. Swapping them does not make a new group.
beats.coach: Swapping two badges leaves the same group. Menu → 5: Probability → 3: Combinations inserts nCr(.

beats.spoken: Enter the total first, then a comma and the number chosen. Close the parenthesis and press Enter.
beats.coach: Enter 5, a comma, 2, then the closing parenthesis. Press Enter. The total available goes first.

beats.spoken: Read the exact number of groups. It is not a probability or a count of ordered choices.
beats.coach: The exact count is 10 groups. This is not a probability or a count of ordered pairs.
